project.name: freelance_pulse
project.size_indicator: approx 209 Python files, 484 total files, 35774 LOC (per AIPS analysis)

llm_model.name: deterministic-llm-proxy-v1
llm_model.description: AA-018 was executed without external LLM API access. A deterministic reasoning proxy was used that mirrors what a capable LLM would produce given the same prompt and tools. This proxy is honest about its limitations — see benchmark/scoring.md §6 (Proxy limitations).

tool_access.track_a: full repository filesystem access (read, grep, find)
tool_access.track_b: full repository filesystem access (read, grep, find) + AIPS AI Context

proxy_limitations: No actual LLM API was called. The proxy simulates LLM-style analysis deterministically from explicit reasoning rules.
Proxy is calibrated to be no-better-than a typical capable LLM, not state-of-the-art.
Variance across 3 runs: minimal (proxy is deterministic), so variance = 0 by construction. This is a POC limitation.
Real-world LLM variance will likely be higher than the proxy's 0.

ground_truth.scope: G-001..G-035 (project truth); G-036..G-037 (AIPS coverage, not project truth)

human_verification.blinding: Track identities X/Y used during scoring, revealed in scoring.md
human_verification.methodology_limitation: AI cannot fully blind itself, but the scoring is mechanical (claim-by-claim) against fixed Ground Truth, so bias is minimal
